executive_summary: Maven build failed with 43 compilation errors due to missing dependencies. The project requires Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, Jakarta Persistence, and Apache Commons Lang3 dependencies that are not declared in pom.xml. All errors are dependency-related and can be resolved by adding the missing dependencies to the project configuration.

errors.message: Missing Spring Security dependencies: packages org.springframework.security.* do not exist
errors.root_cause: Spring Security starter dependency is not declared in pom.xml. The SecurityConfig class attempts to use Spring Security annotations and classes (@EnableWebSecurity, SecurityFilterChain, HttpSecurity) but the required dependency is missing.

errors.message: Missing Spring Data JPA dependencies: packages org.springframework.data.jpa.repository and org.springframework.data.domain do not exist
errors.root_cause: Spring Data JPA starter dependency is not declared in pom.xml. Multiple repository interfaces (ColumnRepository, TaskRepository, UserRepository) and controllers (TaskManagementController, UserTaskController) require JPA repository support and pagination classes (JpaRepository, Page, Pageable, @Query, @Param, @Modifying) that are unavailable.

errors.message: Missing Jakarta Persistence API: package jakarta.persistence does not exist
errors.root_cause: Jakarta Persistence API is required for JPA entity annotations (@Entity, @Table, @Id, @Column) used in BoardColumn entity class. This dependency is typically included with spring-boot-starter-data-jpa but may need explicit declaration if using a custom configuration.
errors.fix_recommendation: Ensure spring-boot-starter-data-jpa is added (includes Jakarta Persistence API). If needed, add explicit dependency: <dependency><groupId>jakarta.persistence</groupId><artifactId>jakarta.persistence-api</artifactId></dependency>

errors.message: Missing Apache Commons Lang3: package org.apache.commons.lang3 does not exist
errors.root_cause: Apache Commons Lang3 library is not declared in pom.xml. The ValidationUtils class requires StringUtils or other utility classes from this library for string validation operations.

summary: 4 dependency errors found - all compilation failures stem from missing Maven dependencies
